evidence: VERIFIED HERE: Compared supplied ORIGINAL and SOURCE a7RouteAccess.test.tsx byte-for-byte and inspected the complete unified diff. The ORIGINAL hashes to Git blob 07091fa4e5fa643ab0a2d7ddc0bab826f34786c5, matching the independently retrieved parent-commit file; SOURCE hashes to 0e2b664585a615e7dd489b9ebe1073c933be36e8, matching the packet. Only learningWeekStores and Hub-specific completion/access assertions change.

VERIFIED HERE: Inspected readLearningDays and its callers. useLearningWeek starts the asynchronous read from PersonalWeek on the RPG Hub; readLearningDays uses one Dexie readonly transaction over sorted stores learner_evidence, progress_entries and study_sessions, calling each(), where(status).equals(completed).each(), and each() respectively. The matching test requires one readonly transaction, all three stores, exactly three cursor operations, and zero materialized rows.

VERIFIED HERE: The Hub waits within the Denne uken card for either Klar for ukens... or Du har... text, which PersonalWeekDetails renders only after days resolves successfully; loading and failure messages do not match. The current Card implementation defaults to a section, so closest(section) is valid. The subsequent probe snapshot therefore follows the awaited weekly read.

VERIFIED HERE: The original aggregate Hub <=11-operation oracle, separate HUD <=10-oracle for applicable child routes, per-route transaction counts and budgets, no-write probe, forbidden-store checks, nonmaterialization checks, and before/after equality over 22 database stores are unchanged and still asserted. The additional weekly transaction is allowed only on Hub.

adversarialFindings.description: The original A7 Hub test incorrectly required one educational transaction although the new PersonalWeek read adds a second transaction, potentially masking an unintended access expansion if only the count were relaxed.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The correction permits exactly two educational transactions on Hub only, retains one aggregate Hub transaction with its original 11-operation budget, and explicitly requires one separate three-store readonly weekly transaction with exactly three cursor operations and zero row materialization. Other route transaction expectations remain unchanged.

adversarialFindings.description: A probe snapshot taken after the Hub aggregate heading but before asynchronous weekly completion could produce a false negative or omit the additional read.
adversarialFindings.resolution: The Hub-specific findByText waits inside the Denne uken section for text emitted only after successful readLearningDays completion. The snapshot is taken subsequently; the source and observed transcript support this ordering.

adversarialFindings.description: Accepting the weekly read must not weaken access budgets for other routes, accidentally allow writes, or conceal mutations to persisted learner data.
adversarialFindings.resolution: All original per-route aggregate/HUD assertions, zero-write and forbidden-store checks, nonmaterialization checks, and complete before/after database snapshot equality are preserved. All seven A7 transcript records report readonly access, zero writes and equality; these are observed reported-run artifacts, not independently rerun results.

adversarialFindings.description: The new commit was available only as an owner-provided local commit/report, not a GitHub-resolvable object; this review cannot independently establish that its full committed tree contains only the inspected test delta.
adversarialFindings.resolution: Accepted for this bounded packet-based review: the parent test was independently matched to repository bytes, the reviewed changed test blob was independently calculated, and the owner supplied the one-file commit summary plus candidate and payload-tree identifiers. The payload identifier is explicitly owner-reported. When the evidence-only successor is created, the repository binding resolver and hosted gate must confirm the actual payload tree equals the recorded value; no additional product/test changes are covered.
